probe_stop_reason: 046 permits a static instrumentation design as a valid return. A mechanism-proving probe would need an evidence-local instrumented dense LiDAR publisher or wrapper that records publisher-side node time, emitted header stamp, steady clock, and matched subscription count at each publish. Running without that publisher-side trace would only reproduce 044-style recorder/FAST-LIO observations and would not answer the publisher-side question. Editing production ROS2 packages is forbidden in 046, so the safe stop point is this source-static design and next-run boundary.

dense_lidar_replay_node.finding: Livox publisher is reliable KeepLast(20); each timer tick sets PointCloud2 header stamp from node now(), copies that stamp to Livox CustomMsg header, derives Livox timebase from it, then publishes PointCloud2 and Livox.

mworks_state_imu_replay_node.finding: IMU/state publisher is reliable KeepLast(64); each timer tick stamps IMU, TF, and truth odometry from node now().

fastlio_livox_callback.finding: FAST-LIO livox_pcl_cbk computes cur_time from msg->header.stamp and clears the LiDAR buffer when cur_time is less than persistent last_timestamp_lidar.

fastlio_subscription_depth.finding: FAST-LIO subscribes to Livox with depth 20 and IMU with depth 10.

instrumentation_strategy.preferred_next_runtime_boundary: Build or launch an evidence-local instrumented dense LiDAR publisher under Results/tmp or the 046 evidence directory, without editing production ROS2 packages, source data, FAST-LIO config, extrinsics, frame adapters, MWORKS, UE, controller, planner, or config files.
allowed_processes_if_probe_runs: evidence-local instrumented dense LiDAR replay publisher

claim_boundary: 046 static design only. It does not run a live probe and does not claim FAST-LIO success, TF/RViz readiness, localization quality, local-map quality, planner_ready, controller performance, mission success, or closed_loop.
